title: The sharp exponential rate of singularity for symmetric Bernoulli matrices
summary: Let A n be a symmetric $`n\times n`$ matrix whose entries on and above the diagonal are independent uniform signs. We prove $`\displaystyle \Pr(\det A_n=0)=\left(\frac12+o(1)\right)^n.`$
family_title: Sharp singularity rates for symmetric random sign matrices

review.reason: Determines the sharp exponential rate of singularity for symmetric random sign matrices.
